items.title: Tariff Driven Supply Chain Shift Puts Flex Stock And Factory Reshoring In Focus

items.summary: Flex Ltd. has been on a powerful multi year run, and with the stock now near recent highs, the real question for investors is whether today's valuation is still grounded in the cash the business can generate.
